vendor.blurb: Cheap, fast text models; Hailuo H3 video went open weights and took #1 on image-to-video

minimax-m3-1-flash-preview.tagline: A fast coding preview for everyday development
highlights: Debuted 9/27 in MiniMax Code, then rolled into Token Plan
Five reasoning levels: low/medium/high/xhigh/max
Positioned as high-throughput, low-latency, from bug fixes to full features
minimax-m3-1-flash-preview.notes: No official scores or third-party leaderboard results yet, so the tier is conservative. After launch, Token Plan quotas temporarily reset twice a day.

highlights: Billed as the first open model with frontier coding, 1M context, native multimodal
Official: SWE-Bench Pro 59.0%, TB 2.1 66.0%
New attention architecture, MSA (MiniMax Sparse Attention)
Only 29 on the new AA index; LMArena Text 1440, #91
minimax-m3.notes: Supports a thinking toggle. It was briefly the top open model at launch, but Terminal-Bench 4.0 is just 2% in AA's new index and the ranking fell sharply; the reference chart also puts it in C.

bench.Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v: Old index score at launch was 55

minimax-m2-7.tagline: Small-active coding model, built to self-evolve
highlights: SWE-Pro 56.2%, level with GPT-5.3-Codex at launch
10B active, plus a highspeed variant
AA index 23; LMArena Code 1397, #84
minimax-m2-7.notes: Weights are open but moved to a non-commercial license, which upset the community. Still listed in MiniMax Code.

minimax-m2-5.tagline: MIT-licensed coding model at $1 an hour
highlights: SWE-bench Verified 80.2%, close to Opus 4.6 at launch
About $1 to run for an hour at 100 tok/s
MIT license, about 34% faster than M2.7
minimax-m2-5.notes: A more permissive license than M2.7, and still a cheap pick for many local and agent frameworks.

highlights: LMArena Image-to-Video 1495, #1; Text-to-Video 1460, #8
AA Text-to-Video v2.0 #4 (1138), Image-to-Video #2, both #1 among open models
Native stereo audio, 2K resolution, 4–15s per clip
References up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio clips per generation
minimax-h3.notes: "H3" refers to this model: official name MiniMax H3, brand name Hailuo 3. Open-sourced 8/3 under a license that excludes the US, EU, UK and South Korea. Post-trained derivatives (fal's H3 Max, Utopai X, available only inside PAI) are not listed separately.

bench.AA Text-to-Video v2.0（带音频）: #4 (768p, 6,343 samples, statistically tied with Seedance 2.5); Utopai X, post-trained from H3, is #2 at 1150
bench.Artificial Analysis Text-to-Video（无音频）: #3 (legacy v1 basis; not verified on the v2.0 no-audio board)

hailuo-2-3.tagline: Last-gen Hailuo, fully superseded by H3
highlights: Improved body motion, facial expression and physical realism
A faster 2.3-Fast variant also exists
LMArena Text-to-Video #32, Image-to-Video #29
hailuo-2-3.notes: No native audio, a wide gap from the newer models with sound. The older Hailuo-02 (2025-06) is not listed separately.

minimax-image-01.tagline: MiniMax's only image model, now clearly behind
highlights: Text-to-image plus subject-reference image-to-image, up to 9 images per run
AA text-to-image 861, #124
Not updated in a year and a half; not on the LMArena text-to-image board
minimax-image-01.notes: Released over 18 months ago, so borderline under listing criteria; kept as a reference because it is MiniMax's only image model and is still on the API.
